description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Order No. 36 to fix a maximum retail price of Rs. 480/- per Kg for Broiler Chicken Meat without skin w.e.f. 10.12.2015. Order No. 37 to fix a maximum retail prices for Dried Sprats, Dhal, Dried Fish, "Katta" & "Salaya" & Chickpeas w.e.f. 10.12.2015.
categorisation: This gazette content contains orders issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 20(5) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes maximum retail prices for specific consumer goods and regulates how they can be sold. This constitutes regulatory matters and statutory instruments, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
